P01.note: 'one at a time' over sixteen years vs a single decree gives piecemeal; duty-free and 'most of the region' kill notional and meager.

P02.note: Threat to leave plus the spared-village contrast gives leverage; forbidden statutes and threatening to leave kill legitimacy and loyalty.

P03.note: Blank's own sentence ('in its driving code... a duty that police could enforce') defines codified.

P04.note: Pencil grids and scraped earlier attempts support rehearsed; the others are not addressed by planted evidence.

P05.note: 'No method for calculating' plus over-building gives uncertainty; 'less a statement of grandeur' kills vanity.

P06.note: 'Did not bring back... but' in the blank's sentence signals stopped, i.e. arrested.

P07.note: His drafts stayed in notebooks while hers appeared in print; 'equally devoted' kills rare and superficial; retrospective is a near-miss describing hers.

P08.note: Stall fees rose by 'nearly the sum' of the toll, so offset; 'nearly' kills outpaced.

P09.note: Grouping by station and hour so no figure traces to one rider is aggregate; classify is a weak near-miss.

P10.note: 'Opening collections... already bought on the resident's behalf' in the blank's sentence gives access and kills currency.

P11.note: Breaking on small deviations (a cough, an extra word) is brittle; 'short, fixed list' kills bloated.

P12.note: 'Rather than to choose between them' in the blank's sentence gives reconcile.

P13.note: Monopoly lapsed in 1713 but dominance lasted forty more years: outlived; the lapse kills preserved.

P14.note: 'Shaped by hard experience, not a weighing of returns' in the blank's sentence gives cautious and kills calculating.

P15.note: 'May set in motion, but largely ___ the range' plus fifteen meters vs centimeters gives governs; the centimeter case kills heightens.

P16.note: Positions preserved but timing lost makes the evidence uneven; requires combining the film and timing sentences.

P17.note: The moved decision is whether a frame is worth keeping, applied to dozens of near-identical shots: culling.

P18.note: 'Interests that shifts left no room to pursue' in the blank's sentence gives outlet; novels kill laboratory.

P19.note: 'Values the two together at exactly $10' points to bundle; alliterative distractors are unrelated.

P20.note: Chloroplasts plus surviving longer under lamps make harvest obvious.

P21.note: Predators strike the blue tail more often and it detaches and twitches: decoy; attracting strikes kills deterrent.

P22.note: Notes, corrections and inserted passages in one sentence give revise.

P23.note: Descriptions reappearing in later novels make the letters a workshop; timing (letters precede novels) kills souvenir.

P24.note: 'Not the ___ of bats alone' wants a distinctive trait: hallmark; independent evolution kills heirloom.

P25.note: Tail trails inbound and leads outbound, so it is independent of travel direction; must combine both legs; tail-first kills inverse.

P26.note: Each copy reached dozens, so copies are a floor on readers: minimum; 'not an estimate' kills median.

P27.note: Nesting within meters of last year's nest is site fidelity, stated in one sentence.

P28.note: Charter unchanged but now actually enforced by blind outside grading: policed; 'never amended' kills overhauled and loosened.

P29.note: Drying kills the minnows; the ditch kills isolation and 'just as fresh' kills freshness.

P30.note: Larvae with a reef-flat parent tolerate heat never experienced: heritable.

P31.note: Characters expanded and subplot cut in response to letters: shape.

P32.note: Prices tripled in three valleys but barely moved downstream: localized; prices tripling kills mild; man-made is a weak near-miss via grain transport.

P33.note: Counting signatures 'instead' of direct evidence is a proxy, given in the first sentence.

P34.note: Offices moving with the court and working as usual give mobile; 'gathered in one camp' kills partitioned and 'working as usual' kills makeshift.

P35.note: Rangers usually right within ten minutes gives foreseeable.

P36.note: Later plants rooted in lupine patches and almost nowhere else: foothold; enrichment kills hurdle.

P37.note: Praise only for range, translations 'serviceable at best', intro ignored: restricted; this kills steadfast.

P38.note: Not refilling positions after retirements and departures is attrition; work divided among colleagues kills automation; no dismissals kills buyouts weakly.

P39.note: Same play performed everywhere and audiences returning yearly: staple.

P40.note: Single booth capping output at forty a day is a bottleneck; 'smoothly it ran' kills breakdown.
